title: A switch as a jump table
description:
Write `price(size)` with a **jump table**: one bounds check, then `jmp` through a table of addresses.

| `size` | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | anything else |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| returns | 250 | 300 | 350 | 300 | -1 |

Sizes 1 and 3 share one case (the table can hold the same address twice).

starter.solution.asm:
price:
        mov     rax, -1
        cmp     rdi, 0
        jne     .done
        mov     eax, 250
.done:  ret

solution.solution.asm:
price:
        cmp     rdi, 3
        ja      .other
        lea     rax, [rel .table]
        jmp     [rax + rdi*8]
.small: mov     eax, 250
        ret
.medium:
        mov     eax, 300
        ret
.large: mov     eax, 350
        ret
.other: mov     rax, -1
        ret

        section .data
        align   8
.table: dq      price.small, price.medium, price.large, price.medium
        section .text

hints: `cmp rdi, 3` / `ja .other` refuses both too large and negative sizes, because `ja` compares as unsigned (lesson 8.03).
Labels local to `price` are written `price.small` from the data section.
rules: Jump through the table with jmp [ ... ].
unitTests:
test "each size"
    price(0) == 250
    price(1) == 300
    price(2) == 350
    price(3) == 300
test "out of range"
    price(4) == -1
    price(100) == -1
    price(-1) == -1

rules.message: Jump through the table with jmp [ ... ].
